Record paired hit indicators hA,hB for each user on identical fixed candidate sets. Estimate Δ=(1/4)Σd mean(hA−hB). Applying [paired resampling](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html) and [stratification](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/boot/html/boot.html): independently within each dataset, resample 200 users with replacement, preserving each user's two outcomes; recompute Δ for ≥10,000 replicates. Report observed per-dataset differences, macro difference, and a clearly specified approximate 95% bootstrap interval, e.g. percentile. Keep datasets equally weighted and candidates fixed; never resample the two models independently. This requires per-user outcomes; aggregate HR alone is insufficient.

For each dataset, count discordances b=A-only hits and c=B-only hits. Use two-sided exact McNemar: test b against Binomial(b+c,0.5); concordant pairs contribute no evidence. Report b,c and effect sizes alongside p-values; adjust four confirmatory category tests, e.g. Holm. [McNemar documentation](https://www.statsmodels.org/stable/generated/statsmodels.stats.contingency_tables.mcnemar.html). For an overall test, swap model labels independently within user pairs and recompute macro Δ; validity requires within-pair exchangeability under the null. Equal dataset sizes make this equivalent to pooling discordances under the stronger datasetwise symmetry null; it does not merely test zero macro effect with arbitrary opposing category effects.

Label validation intervals and tests exploratory: repeated checkpoint/hyperparameter selection on those users creates selection optimism that bootstrapping the chosen predictions cannot remove. [Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/volume11/cawley10a/cawley10a.pdf). Uncertainty is conditional on seed-42 fitted models, fixed candidates and these four datasets; it excludes training-seed, negative-sampling and between-dataset variation. Assume independent users, clustering repeated identities if necessary. Freeze selection before the host's untouched held-out evaluation; do not claim seed robustness or full-catalog performance.
